Chief_Complaint.content: Intermittent tingling of right toes after running

Patient runs 4–8 miles per session
Knee pain starts around 20 minutes into run, approximately mile 2.5–3
Knee pain has been worsening, last run required stopping
Pain is located in the central right knee, slightly toward the right side
